facts.fact: An expert told APS on 27 March 2026 that law 2008-12 of 25 January 2008 is the current Senegalese data protection law, now outdated for generative AI, and that Senegal is late in updating it.
The same expert said a bill was reportedly already in the circuit and that the National Assembly must vote it; no stage of the bill is given.
